correctness.rationale: For every field and n>=2, adapted resultant F=sum c_i a^(n-i)b^i is the dual of S(1,n). The finite incidence map P1xPn -> D is birational and smooth upstairs. On monic charts the inclusion R=direct sum A b^i x^i inside B=direct sum A x^i has conductor precisely b^(n-1) B: the generic irreducible Q field disallows lower b-adic order. Descent gives I_Lambda^(n-1) globally. All c_i derivatives span (a,b)^n. For p|n, Euler gives F_a=-bG,F_b=aG, yielding generic Hilbert graded dims (1,2,...,n-1,n-2) and polar degree1; outside p|n generic degree n-1. Stratifying L=0 gives the motivic/count formula. Exhaustive independent F3 n2 projective count=49, matching 1+3+2*9+27; separate graded-length sanity for n=3..8. Note for n=2 no strict polar degree drop.
